verdict.rationale: The SDK is a library published on GitHub that you run in your own code through the Runner class, so the core runtime runs in your environment. It is provider-agnostic, covering 100+ non-OpenAI LLMs, and its OpenAI tracing export can be disabled. However, several features remain OpenAI-hosted: the Traces dashboard and the managed tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP). Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting or open-source license documentation, self-hostable equivalents of the tracing dashboard and hosted tools, and independent hands-on confirmation of fully self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.
You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()
You can globally disable tracing by setting the env var `OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1`
